blurb: Boca Rio Golf Club is a member-owned private golf club with a 7,100-yard, par-72 course designed by Robert Von Hagge. The club offers a golf experience with no tee times required, skilled caddies, and a 36,000-square-foot clubhouse with dining and event spaces. Membership is limited to 175 members with golf privileges, emphasizing tradition, privacy, and luxury.
